environment.import_method: OpenUtau-saved projects reopened (A13); a script-modified copy of an OpenUtau-saved project opened and rendered

input.description: Create, save, inspect, reopen a tiny project

expected.summary: Script-generated or modified projects are a separate later experiment.

observed.summary: A project saved after assigning ALYS to four tracks was reopened with singer alys-db-002-fra, WORLDLINE-R and the default phonemizer intact. A script edited that file's tempo (120 to 90) and lyrics (a to la); it opened with tempo 90 and the singer intact, and the exported stems ended at 2.0, 2.667, 3.333 and 4.0 s, exactly the 90 BPM positions of the last notes at beats 3, 4, 5 and 6.

classification_note: Project-file compatibility, not unattended rendering. OpenUtau reopened its own saved project with singer, renderer and phonemizer intact; a copy edited by a script (every lyric changed and the tempo changed from 120 to 90) loaded in 0.1.565 and the exported stems reflected the edits. The GUI was still used to open and export.

details.unattended_rendering: not established (the GUI opened the file and exported)
